text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated KV cache OOMs on hosted runtime (redwood/gptx-13b-quant). ~35% p50 latency spikes, 503/500 errors increasing across many routes. First seen at 2026-03-15T10:07:14Z.

mia: saw the alert, paging oncall-ml. tagging Ivan and Sanjay. any quick wins?

sanjay: logs show repeated OOMs during prefix allocation: `AllocatorError: failed to allocate 8192MB for kv_cache_slot (requested 12000MB total)` then rapid retries. appears triggered by a small number of very long prompts (30k+ tokens) + continuous batching merging contexts.

ivan: taking oncall. quick triage: looks like continuous batching is merging very long request contexts into large KV windows, causing runaway memory usage. likely regression from the batching heuristic change earlier today (max_window_merge relaxed).

carla: confirming, I've repro'd locally with a synthetic long prompt sequence. KV cache grows without eviction until OOM. we should stop batching for that model immediately and purge affected KV caches.

ivan: agreed. proposed immediate mitigation steps (hotfix):
1) Disable continuous batching for redwood/gptx-13b-quant on hosted runtime.
2) Purge KV caches for that model across the region.
3) Add temporary routing fallback to memsafe variant (redwood/gptx-13b-quant-memsafe).
4) Throttle ingress for requests > 10k tokens and return 413 with guidance.

mia: please run changes and post commands here. we need to notify CS about impacted customers.

carla: running commands now. attaching what I'm using:

```
# Disable continuous batching for model
redwoodctl runtime update-model-config \
  --model redwood/gptx-13b-quant \
  --set continuous_batching=false \
  --reason "hotfix: prevent KV cache blowup from long prompts"

# Purge KV cache on all pods (rolling)
redwoodctl runtime cache purge --model redwood/gptx-13b-quant --region us-west-2 --confirm

# Add routing fallback to memsafe variant
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --model redwood/gptx-13b-quant --fallback redwood/gptx-13b-quant-memsafe
```

carla: started purge at 10:15Z, disabling batching now. will monitor pod restarts.

oncall-ml: taking handoff from Ivan. I'll run patch verification and watch metrics. @cs-bot can you post impacted customer list?

cs-bot: Impact summary (real-time scrape):
- cust-acme (high traffic) - saw 500s since 10:08Z
- cust-nimbus (trial) - multiple request failures
- cust-lyra (low freq) - intermittent 503s
- ~27 other developer accounts - transient errors
(IDs attached to internal ticket 4572)

sanjay: while purge is running, we should also add a guard on request ingestion that rejects requests with token_count > 10240 with a helpful message. avoids repeat offender requests.

ivan: agreed. I'll push a quick ingress rule to edge that returns 413 for >10240 tokens and suggests chunking. patching edge now.

carla: purge completed across us-west-2 at 10:22Z. disabled continuous batching confirmed on control plane. routing fallback applied.

ops-bot: Deploy event recorded: model-config-update by carla at 2026-03-15T10:16:02Z, routing-change by carla at 2026-03-15T10:18:10Z.

oncall-ml: watching metrics — error rate dropping. 10:28Z: 500s back to baseline for most tenants. some retry storms still visible for cust-acme; CS to coordinate customer-side retries.

mia: drafting customer-facing update. suggestion: short explanation + mitigation + ETA for permanent fix.

cs-bot: Draft notice to affected customers:
"We observed transient service errors driven by very long input contexts that caused memory pressure in our hosted runtime's KV cache. We have applied an emergency mitigation (disabled continuous batching for the affected model, purged in-memory caches, and routed traffic to a memsafe variant). If you see errors, please retry after 2 minutes. We are working on a permanent fix and will share an ETA in the incident postmortem."

ivan: good. next: medium-term fixes to prevent recurrence:
- enforce max context at ingress (hard limit + nicer error)
- introduce per-tenant soft kv_cache quota with eviction when exceeded
- revert/adjust batching heuristic change that relaxed merge limits
- add alert for sustained KV cache growth per pod (not just OOM)

sanjay: also add unit/e2e tests for long prompt sequences to catch this in CI.

carla: adding a quick hotfix to runtime to make kv_cache allocations fail-fast when above threshold (so we can return 5xx faster rather than OOM). will post PR shortly.

oncall-ml: status update at 10:35Z: remediation in place, error rate normalized to baseline; rolling back temporary measures will wait for postmortem and validation. handing back to platform oncall.

mia: thanks team. oncall-ml please hand off remaining follow-ups to Platform backlog and create incident doc. I'll schedule a 1-hour postmortem with eng-runtime and infra tomorrow.

oncall-ml: handing off. creating incident page and linking ticket 4572. initial severity: Sev2 due to customer impact but mitigation applied.

carla: saved logs/snippets to the incident doc: `oom_backtrace.log`, `batching-change-diff.patch`, `purge_runbook.md`.

mia: final: remember to bump alert thresholds to include sustained kv_cache growth (not only OOM) and add a dashboard for per-model kv_cache bytes. tagging Ivan and Sanjay for the follow-up action items.

ops-bot: Incident update recorded: mitigated at 2026-03-15T10:35:50Z. Postmortem owner: mia.

sanjay: end of thread notes: root cause likely combination of heuristic change + unbounded user input. mitigation checklist created. postmortem will include timeline, root cause, and planned fixes.

cs-bot: Notifying customer success & sending templated customer update now.

mia: thanks everyone. closing on-call handoff. please add any downstream items to ticket 4572.
